[ASSISTANT_SAID] Upgrading the RAM can improve performance but is unlikely to affect battery life.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested troubleshooting steps for battery life issues include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Battery calibration by draining to 0% and charging to 100% 2-3 times.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Checking for power-hungry RAM consumption.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Monitoring system resource usage using Task Manager.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Adjusting power management settings in Windows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Checking for BIOS updates.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested general tips to optimize battery life:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Adjust screen brightness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Turn off unnecessary devices like Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Use power-saving features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Update the operating system.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Monitor system resource usage.
